notes.title: Patch 2.00 released
notes.content:
Hear ye hear ye citizens of Ding Dong Dell!

The latest update for Ni No Kuni II, Patch 2.00 adds the following features:

- 10 additional floors (31 to 40) in Faraway Forest for Hard difficulties or higher.
- New item drops on the previously mentioned floors.
- New bosses to encounter on the previously mentioned floors.
- New costumes for Evan, Roland and Tani.
- New Steam achievements specific to the Adventure Pack DLC.
- Additional quests after completing the campaign.


Fixes:
- Fixed several minor graphical/text bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - New difficulty levels
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30281808/072507c8148bc76aa4ccae6a5a8e60f986f19da7.jpg[/img]Building your kingdom is a challenging task, and your journey is about to get even more difficult. Watch the Difficulty Patch trailer for more details about the various difficulty levels added:

Good luck, young king!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is live!
notes.content:
It’s been a few weeks since the release of Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom and we’ve been reading your feedback online. We’d like to thank the community for their support! Please find below our first patch notes. We’ll continue to read your feedback!

Improvements:

*Improved the game stability
*Added a shortcut for "SAVE" in the main menu
*Added special icon on the message that appear before the battle with tainted monsters
*Added region names on the map menu when zoomed out
*Made "Lock/Unlock settings" for users to lock/unlock the equipment when changing them at the main menu
*Changed the color of skirmish flag effect when the battle is cleared
*Changed the timing of the pose during the victory screen when the battle is finished
*Added help comment for citizen rank up and save
*Fixed the bug during the side quest 051 "Trainee Priestess Speio" where quest will not proceed even when the magic "Rejuvenate" is learned
*Fixed the bug caused by the order of the actions during Chapter 6, the Factory floors.
*Fixed other minor bugs
*Improved camera movements when a PC mouse is used
*Fixed the screen blackout when [CapsLock] key and [Q] key is pressed at the same time during the full screen mode
*Fixed the drop of framerate when 2 monitor screens are used
